summary: Final report MV-2022-176 for Orvessant Biosciences Pty Ltd: Five-isoform DDI screen on 40 compounds (Piperidyl benzamide). Study summary (benchmark) table on page 1; full compound tables, methods and control results follow.

title_block.title: OB11 GPCR antagonists: five-isoform CYP inhibition at screening concentration
title_block.subtitle: Final Report

blocks.p: 40 compounds from the Orvessant piperidyl benzamide series 11 were tested for Orvessant Biosciences Pty Ltd in the Five-isoform DDI screen. Testing started on July 25, 2022 and results were reported on August 10, 2022. All runs met matrix acceptance criteria. Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP2C9.
To rank the test article set for Five-isoform DDI screen liability so that Orvessant Biosciences Pty Ltd could choose analogues for progression.
40 compounds were received as 10 mM DMSO solutions in one accession lot on July 25, 2022 and logged against M22/BIO/04063. Identity and concentration were taken as supplied by the client.

Pooled human liver microsomes (0.1 mg/mL protein) were incubated with each compound at 10 µM and an isoform-selective probe substrate at approximately Km, in duplicate, for 10 minutes at 37 °C after NADPH addition. Metabolite formation was measured by LC-MS/MS against vehicle (0.1% DMSO) incubations.
Results are reported as mean percent inhibition relative to vehicle. Values above 50% at 10 µM are flagged for follow-up; small negative values indicate no inhibition.

Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP2C9. In total {{PRJ0006:cyp.n_any_gt50}} compounds inhibited at least one isoform by more than 50% at 10 µM (CYP3A4: {{PRJ0006:cyp.n_gt50_CYP3A4}}; CYP2D6: {{PRJ0006:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2D6}}; CYP2C19: {{PRJ0006:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2C19}}; CYP2C9: {{PRJ0006:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2C9}}; CYP1A2: {{PRJ0006:cyp.n_gt50_CYP1A2}}). Ketoconazole inhibited CYP3A4 with an IC50 of {{PRJ0006:cyp.control_CYP3A4_uM}} µM.

Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP2C9. Inhibition values are in vitro, at a fixed concentration, and do not by themselves predict clinical interaction risk; free exposure estimates are needed for that assessment.
The data support ranking within the set. Recommended next step: carry the compounds without CYP flags into exposure studies and run CYP3A4 IC50s for flagged analogues before in vivo work.
